spec_raw: Menu styling within the Side Navigation component is different from standalone menus

spec_refined.title: Side Navigation: menus should have consistent styling with standalone menus
spec_refined.description: When menus are placed inside modus-wc-side-navigation, they render with different styles than identical menus used standalone. Both should use the same token-based styling.
acceptance_criteria: Menu items inside side-nav and standalone use the same background/hover token
No hardcoded color values in menu selectors within the side-nav stylesheet
Side-nav uses modus-wc-menu component base classes for menu styling
Visual styling is consistent between slotted menus and standalone menus
spec_refined.technical_notes: Style-only change in modus-wc-side-navigation.scss or tailwind.ts. Check how menus are styled differently inside the side-nav shadow DOM.
